assumptions: Correction cell rings represent physical source spaces with horizontal floor/ceiling boundaries.
Contacts describe adjacency, not traversability or EnergyPlus surface pairing.
Only explicit openings are represented; absent observations do not establish a solid wall.
Source boundary identity follows cell identity and ring order; topology edits need identity migration.
Wall thickness 240 mm nominal: partitions are drawn as single ink lines or thin line pairs with '240' labels; exterior walls drawn ~10 px filled.
Interior door heights 2.1 m assumed; no interior elevation is supplied. Exterior doors use their elevation chains (sill 0.2, head 2.6).
Floor level taken as z=0; elevation chains measure from the drawn grade line, which may sit slightly below finished floor.
Roof assumed flat at eaves height 4.5 m shown on all four elevations; no roof plan supplied.

The corridor strip, east hall and SE desk area are not separated by drawn walls (wall-C stops at the corridor, wall-E return stub ends at y~752 px), so they compile as one connected open space; door D8 in wall-E still separates the SE desk area from the east hall on that side.
Plan spaces were compiled deterministically from the declared footprint and physical partition segments; no snapping, extension, clipping, or inferred partition was applied.
